action: Poses the hand/fingers in front of the face: everything except the hand is masked (the hand shows dark as the unmasked part), and the Gizmo rotates the fingers into place.
why: Pose a hand on the sculpt by masking and rotating, rather than resculpting.
reader_equivalent: Mask then rotate with Sculpt transform tool / Pose brush, or armature pose

action: The jacket is a low-poly shell (visible flat facets on sleeves and collar, SDiv 3) with a separate polygroup strip for the zip placket; he presses fold forms into it with ZSub.
tool: Zmenos (ZSub) brush on subdivided ZRemesher mesh
why: Big fold shapes go in at a low subdivision level so they stay broad and clean.
reader_equivalent: Multires level 2-3 + Draw/Clay subtract; face set for the placket

action: At a higher level he draws long soft tension folds from the shoulder down the sleeve and back.
why: Folds follow the pull from the shoulder and bent arm.
reader_equivalent: Clay Strips / Draw for folds, Smooth

action: Back view at SDiv 3: diagonal drag folds from the hand in the pocket up toward the shoulder blade.
why: Check that folds radiate from the pocketed hand and read from behind.

action: Close work on the jacket front and side seam: a crisp seam line runs down the side, small compression folds where the hand enters the pocket.
why: Seams and pocket pull give the garment structure.
reader_equivalent: Crease for seam, Draw/Clay subtract for small folds

action: High-collar close up: the zip placket is a raised flat strip with sharp edges over the collar, collar top rolled.
why: Hard-edged garment trim against soft collar.
reader_equivalent: Face set -> extrude/inset or separate strip object

action: Full-figure front and back renders, then face close-ups: spiky separate tapered hair locks, wrapped blindfold with wrinkles, smile line, long fingers.
why: Present and check full-body proportions front and back.
